Analyst Sees Stability In Production Ramp-Up

analyst Anthony Valentini initiated coverage of Boeing with an Overweight rating and a $300 price forecast. The analyst sees opportunities in the commercial aircraft market and aftermarket services, citing sustained demand for fleet upgrades and signs of greater stability in Boeing’s production ramp-up.
Valentini also sees stronger growth potential in defense technology firms than in established large-cap defense contractors, according to the report.
